goal: Settle a transfer between two ledger accounts with an idempotent receipt per tx_id.
invariants: INV-01 conservation: the sum of balances before and after settling is the same
INV-02 no balance is left negative
acceptance: a repeated tx_id with the same payload returns the cached receipt and adds no entries
rejected_alternatives: float64 (breaks the exact conservation of INV-01)
pessimistic lock on the balance table (violates p99)
